create.name: Dorothy Hunt
create.bio:
Dorothy Hunt is a teacher of nondual awakening based in San Francisco. Her own path ran from time with Mother Teresa in Calcutta, through the Advaita of Ramana Maharshi and of Ramesh Balsekar, to Adyashanti, who in 2004 asked her to teach within his lineage. She is spiritual director of Moon Mountain Sangha, a small non-profit formed in 2006 around her teaching, and some years earlier she set up a San Francisco centre bringing meditation and psychotherapy together.

Her teaching points away from techniques and towards the open, aware presence that she says is always already here, before any idea of God, Buddha or self. She is wary of spiritual seeking that turns 'the Absolute' into a new identity, and speaks often about letting awakening include ordinary human feeling, relationship and difficulty. She holds a free monthly online meditation and satsang on Zoom, leads occasional retreat days, and meets people one to one for dokusan, the Zen word for a private meeting with a teacher, now mostly by phone. Her books include the poetry collections Only This! and Leaves from Moon Mountain, and Ending the Search.

courses.title: Dokusan (private meetings with Dorothy Hunt)
courses.description: One-to-one meetings with her as a spiritual teacher, held mostly by phone, arranged through Moon Mountain Sangha's contact form. Fees go to the sangha, a non-profit.

free_resources.title: Monthly Meditation & Satsang (online)
free_resources.description: A two-hour gathering on Zoom on the fourth Tuesday evening of most months, Pacific time, with meditation and satsang with Dorothy. It is free, with donations to Moon Mountain Sangha welcome; register on the page for the link.
